content.title: Post Malone and more play free March Madness concerts. See date, times
content.text: April 3, 2026, 1:25 p.m. ETThose flocking to downtown Indianapolis this weekend during the grand finale of the NCAA Men's Championship Basketball games have a chance to catch some of the biggest names in music, and they can listen for free.The entry-free March Madness Music Festival begins Friday, April 3. It's part of a collection of fan events for Final Four weekend, running until April 6. Here's what to know.What musical artists are coming to Indianapolis during the Final Four?Country hip-hop heavy hitter Post Malone is slated to perform at the March Madness Music Festival at American Legion Mall on April 5.The festival also will feature alternative duo Twenty One Pilots, country group Zac Brown Band and surging pop country star Megan Moroney.When is the March Madness Music Festival? Where is it?The festival runs April 3-5 at the American Legion Mall, 700 N. Pennsylvania Street, in downtown Indianapolis.Can I see Post Malone free? Is the March Madness Music Festival free?Yes, entry into the March Madness Music Festival is free. The festival is split into three days: the AT&T Block Party April 3, Coca Cola Live April 4 and the Capital One JamFest finale April 5.Each day of the festival will feature a number of supporting acts. Here's who's playing and when.Friday, April 3 musical lineup for AT&T Block PartyLo-fi alternative artist keshi and hip-hop duo Joey Valence and Brae will join Twenty One Pilots April 3.4:30 p.m. — Event opens5:00 p.m. — Joey Valence & Brae6:45 p.m. — keshi8:30 p.m. — Twenty One Pilots10:00 p.m. — Event endsSaturday, April 4 musical lineup for Coca-Cola Live!R&B singer-songwriter Ravyn Lenae, country hip-hop fuser BRELAND and recently announced country singer Russell Dickerson will join Zac Brown Band April 4.2:30 p.m. — Event opens3:15 p.m. — Breland4:45 p.m. — Ravyn Lenae6:15 p.m. — Russell Dickerson8:10 p.m. — Zac Brown Band10:00 p.m. — Event endsLate Saturday April 4: 'Madness After Dark' event with DJ setThe NCAA has also announced a Madness After Dark with a DJ set from The Chainsmokers, the popular EDM duo behind the 2016 hit, "Closer."The free event happens 10 p.m. to 2 a.m., April 4, from at the Indiana Roof Ballroom.Sunday, April 5 musical lineup for the Capital One JamFestIndie pop artist Dominic Fike will join Malone and Moroney April 5.3:00 p.m. — Event opens4:30 p.m. — Dominic Fike6:15 p.m. — Megan Moroney8:15 p.m. — Post Malone10:30 p.m. — Event endsWhat else is happening during Final Four weekend?Other festivities during the Final Four weekend include a Final Four Fan Fest setup at the Indiana Convention Center, open practices for the competing teams at Lucas Oil Stadium during Final Four Friday April 3 and watch parties along Georgia Street for the Tailgate Tip-Off.Contact IndyStar Pop Culture Reporter Heather Bushman at hbushman@indystar.com. Follow her on X @hmb_1013.John Tufts covers trending news for IndyStar and Midwest Connect. Send him a news tip at John.Tufts@IndyStar.com. Find him on BlueSky at JohnWritesStuff.
